included.title: What the package includes
included.session: A private one-on-one 60-minute online session with Mihai Daniel, about your portfolio, risks, and the decisions you need to make.
included.analyses: 2 premium technical analyses, the same product as on Știrile Crypto: seven charts (1h, 4h, 12h, 1D, 3D, 1W, 1M) and the token-risk section, for two assets you choose.
included.delivery: The analyses are sent by email, from contact@stirilecrypto.ro. Indicative delivery: 24 hours on working days.
included.scope: The session adapts to your questions. It is not a written audit of the entire portfolio and it does not replace regulated financial advice.
included.educational: The analyses are educational material. They do not contain calls to buy or sell.
included.listPrice: The list price of an analysis bought separately stays 79 RON (large coin, top 30) and 139 RON (altcoin). In the consulting package, the two analyses are included in the €200.

process.title: How it works, in 3 steps

write.title: You write to me.
write.body: An email to contact@stirilecrypto.ro is enough. Tell me briefly what you want to discuss and, if you already know, the two assets for the analyses.

meet.title: We set the date and hold the session.
meet.body: We meet one-on-one, online, for 60 minutes, based on your questions and your situation.

delivery.title: You receive the analyses by email.
delivery.body: The two premium technical analyses are sent from contact@stirilecrypto.ro, usually within 24 hours on working days.

process.prepare: You can prepare in advance the list of questions you want to cover in the hour.

analysis.title: Technical analysis
analysis.body: One analysis for a single asset: seven timeframes, from 1h to 1M, plus the token-risk section. 79 lei for large coins, 139 lei for an altcoin. Indicative delivery within 24 working hours, by email.
analysis.note: If you take the consulting package, the two analyses are already included. If you only want the analysis, you order it separately on Știrile Crypto.
